# Función auxiliar que aplica un layout común a cualquier objeto plotly.
estilo_muestreo <- function(p, titulo = NULL, eje_x = NULL, eje_y = NULL,
                            mostrar_leyenda = TRUE) {
  p %>% layout(
    title  = if (!is.null(titulo))
               list(text = titulo, x = 0.02, xanchor = "left",
                    font = list(size = 16))
             else NULL,
    xaxis  = list(title = eje_x, gridcolor = "#E5E5E5",
                  zerolinecolor = "#CCCCCC"),
    yaxis  = list(title = eje_y, gridcolor = "#E5E5E5",
                  zerolinecolor = "#CCCCCC"),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = -0.18,
                  bgcolor = "rgba(255,255,255,0)"),
    margin = list(l = 70, r = 30, t = 60, b = 80),
    font   = list(family = "Lato, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif", size = 12,

    hoverlabel = list(font = list(family = "Lato, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif"),
                      bgcolor = "#FFFFFF"),
    plot_bgcolor  = "#FFFFFF",
    paper_bgcolor = "#FFFFFF",
    showlegend    = mostrar_leyenda
  )
}
